facts.description: Built to refine the performance and reliability of the Gemini 3 Pro series, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview provides better thinking, improved token efficiency, and a more grounded, factually consistent experience. It's optimized for software engineering behavior and usability, as well as agentic workflows requiring precise tool usage and reliable multi-step execution across real-world domains.
